name: 06. Chatwoot Inbound → Hermes API Externa (Protótipo)

fluxo: 2. Monta payload com: system_prompt completo, dados do lead (external_id, name, email, phone), conversation_id, message, source, required_output
4. Envia reply do Hermes de volta ao Chatwoot via API (PLACEHOLDER: conta/conversa)
5. Registra nota no HubSpot com: mensagem lead, resposta Hermes, handoff_required, next_action
6. Responde webhook com: {ok: true, routed_to, conversation_id, handoff_required}
